newsitem.title: GERMANY: VW plans special shifts up to year-end.
newsitem.headline: VW plans special shifts up to year-end.

text.p: Volkswagen said on Monday it was introducing a total of 30 special shifts in its Wolfsburg plant up until the end of this year to try to reduce delivery times for certain popular models.

The company said the special shifts would speed production of its Golf and Polo models and of the Seat Arosa which is also made at the plant. Currently a buyer has to wait six to eight weeks for a Golf or Polo and about 12 weeks for an Arosa.
Each special shift allows production on that day to be increased by about 50 percent. In a normal day about 1,300 Golfs, 400 Polos and 250 Arosas are made at that plant.
VW declined to comment on the orders in hand for these models.
